data.body: Cross-epic notes (2026-09-07 overlap analysis): (1) `docs/README.md:142` is also edited by the eval-harness story decorative-taut-armedcrab (it repoints the surviving `calibration/` links to `evals/calibration/`); this story removes the `overlap_batch_confidence.md` link from the same sentence; whichever lands second re-applies its edit to the sentence as it then stands.
